transcript: This recorded notice was shared this morning. Welcome to the Night Market Walk tour at the science room. We will first visit the model room, then the photo hall, and finally the workshop. Photography is allowed in the first two rooms but not in the workshop. Keep your ticket because the guide will check it at the last door.
